newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk Isbank to raise capital to 50 trln lira.
newsitem.headline: Turk Isbank to raise capital to 50 trln lira.

text.p: Turkiye Is Bankas A.S., one of Turkey's biggest commercial banks, said it would raise its paid-in capital to 50.66 trillion lira ($322.7 million), from the current 10 trillion lira.

In a statement to the exchange, the bank said the capital would be increased by issuing 4.07 trillion lira or 0.4 rights share for one existing share and 36.6 trillion lira or 3.4 bonus share for one existing share.
The increase must be approved by the regulatory Capital Market Board (SPK) before taking effect. ATA ($ = 156980 Turkish Lira)
